exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Is summer your favourite time of year? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: What do you do in summer when the weather's very hot? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you go on holiday every summer? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Did you enjoy the summer holidays when you were at school? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a luxury item you would like to own in the future. You should say: what item you would like to own what this item looks like why you would like to own this item and explain whether you think you will ever own this item.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Expensive items Which expensive items would many young people (in your country) like to buy?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Expensive items How do the expensive items that younger people want to buy differ from those that older people want to buy?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Expensive items Do you think that people are more likely to buy expensive items for their friends or for themselves?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Rich people How difficult is it to become very rich in today's world?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Rich people Do you agree that money does not necessarily bring happiness?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Rich people In what ways might rich people use their money to help society?
